(schema)  version=3
    markdown: "Coralogix Alert. For more info check - https://coralogix.com/docs/getting-started-with-coralogix-alerts/."
access_policy  StringAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "JSON string representing the access policy for this alert. It defines granular permissions for users and groups. When set, the provider owns the policy and re-applies it whenever the alert is updated, reverting changes made elsewhere; for keys with `alerts:ReadAccessPolicy`, changes made elsewhere also show as drift on refresh. Set to `\"\"` to delete the existing policy without a replacement; a policy added elsewhere is then removed on the next update. When omitted, the policy is left unmanaged and unchanged. While this attribute is set (including `\"\"`), every update of the alert sends the policy and therefore requires the `alerts:UpdateAccessPolicy` permission; remove the line to stop managing it. Reading the policy back requires `alerts:ReadAccessPolicy`: without it the attribute is not refreshed from the backend and drift is not detected."
    plan modifier: dashboard_schema.PreserveStateForEquivalentJSON Preserves the previous state value when the configured JSON is semantically equivalent.
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
case_settings  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Case settings for the alert (preview): whether cases auto-resolve, a query that enriches the case, and where case notifications are sent. Case destinations are independent of `notification_group.destinations`; both are delivered. Removing this block clears the case settings."
case_settings.auto_resolve_mode  StringAttribute optional computed
    default: stringdefault.staticStringDefault value defaults to enabled
    markdown: "Whether the case is resolved automatically when the alert resolves. Valid values: [\"enabled\" \"disabled\"]. Defaults to `enabled`."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["disabled" "enabled"]
case_settings.destinations  ListNestedAttribute optional computed
    default: listdefault.staticValueDefault value defaults to []
    markdown: "Notification Center destinations notified about the cases opened by this alert. The API accepts at most 100 destinations and rejects two destinations with the same `connector_id`, `preset_id` and `condition`."
case_settings.destinations[]  NestedObject
case_settings.destinations[].condition  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Notification Center routing condition that decides whether this destination is notified. Use `\"true\"` to notify on every case notification, or filter on `caseMetadata.notificationReason` (for example `caseMetadata.notificationReason == 'caseResolved'`)."
case_settings.destinations[].connector_id  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "ID of the Notification Center connector to notify. The connector must support the `cases` entity type, for example through a `config_overrides` entry with `entity_type = \"cases\"`."
case_settings.destinations[].preset_id  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "ID of the Notification Center preset used to render the notification. The preset must be defined for the `cases` entity type and the connector's type (for example `preset_system_generic_https_cases_empty`). When omitted, the connector type's default preset is used."
case_settings.enrichment_queries  ListNestedAttribute optional computed
    default: listdefault.staticValueDefault value defaults to []
    markdown: "Queries that enrich the cases opened by this alert. The API accepts at most one query."

    markdown: "The enrichment query."

    markdown: "The query language. Valid values: [\"dataprime\"]. Defaults to `dataprime`."

phantom_mode  BoolAttribute optional computed
    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to false
    markdown: "When `true`, the alert is evaluated but stays silent: it sends no notifications and opens no incident of its own. Use it for alerts that serve as building blocks of a flow alert, which then notifies and opens the incident. The Coralogix API rejects a phantom alert whose `notification_group` sets `group_by_keys`, `webhooks_settings`, `destinations` or `router`. Omit `notification_group` or leave it empty. Defaults to `false`."
